homepage.title.message: Open-source Hardware & Wireless Communication Tech Sharing

homepage.description.message: Focused on ESP32P4 smartwatches, LVGL UI development, Meshtastic mesh networks, open-source hardware projects and hands-on tutorials.

homepage.hero.tagline.message: Build an open-source, decentralized mesh network with low-cost, low-power hardware — no base stations, no public internet, pure peer-to-peer wireless communication.

homepage.downloads.description.message: Connect to and control your hardware across platforms. Pick the client that fits your environment.

homepage.features.encrypted.description.message: AES-256 encryption protects message privacy and data security

homepage.features.noInfrastructure.descr.message: Works independently, free from cell towers, WiFi and the internet

offGrid.heroDesc.message: Meshtastic is an open-source project based on LoRa radio, letting you communicate freely with people nearby via cheap nodes when your phone has no signal, during outages, disasters, or wilderness adventures. No SIM card, no base station.

offGrid.featuresSub.message: A decentralized protocol running over LoRa

offGrid.feat.decentralizedDesc.message: No central server; nodes auto-relay and the network self-heals.

offGrid.feat.rangeDesc.message: LoRa's long-range特性 reaches several to over ten kilometers in open areas.

offGrid.feat.encryptDesc.message: Optional message encryption protects your privacy from eavesdropping.

offGrid.feat.groupDesc.message: Supports group chat, GPS location broadcast and offline message storage.

offGrid.feat.phoneDesc.message: Pair with your phone App via Bluetooth / WiFi, no data needed.

offGrid.feat.openDesc.message: Firmware and App are fully open source; hardware costs only tens of yuan.

offGrid.downloadSub.message: Download the Meshtastic App, flash firmware to your device, and communicate off-grid within minutes.

offGrid.sponsorsSub.message: Thanks to the communities and individuals contributing to the off-grid ecosystem

offGrid.dialog.sub.message: Connect your device here to flash / update Meshtastic firmware
